{"metadata":{"description":"Skin switcher + custom wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): curated --dsw-alias-* palettes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur controls, persisted per browser (like Codex themes) — 换皮肤 / 自定义背景插件","id":"gh:1333619228","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-skin","slug":"KinGao294/dsh-skin","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","skin","theme","wallpaper"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Skin switcher + custom wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): curated --dsw-alias-* palettes, translu"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"cent wallpaper with opacity/blur controls, persisted per browser (like Codex themes) — 换皮肤 / 自定义背景插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-skin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Skin switcher + custom wallpaper + **奶龙桌宠（desktop pet with sticker pack）**
for DeepSeek Harness — a "},{"id":"p3s2","text":""change the skin" feature in the spirit of Codex
themes. It registers a curated catalog of palettes "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"into DSH's built-in theme
runtime and adds three rows to **Settings → General** (below the built-in
"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"-in theme
runtime and adds three rows to **Settings → General** (below the built-in
Appearance row):"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- **皮肤 / Skins** — pick one of 7 curated palettes (or **默认 / Default** to
follow the built-in appear"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ance).
- **背景图片 / Wallpaper** — local image, or paste an image/video URL; opacity,
blur, and fit (co"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ver / contain / stretch / tile).
- **奶龙桌宠 / Pet** — a floating, draggable yellow-dragon desktop pet "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"with an
8-mood sticker pack (表情包). It follows the agent's running state
(idle → thinking → working →"},{"id":"p4s5","text":" done → sleeping), blinks while idle, falls
asleep when idle too long, can be dragged anywhere (posi"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"tion remembered),
and shows a 🎨 sticker panel where you can pick any mood manually. Toggle it,
resiz"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"e it, or reset its position from the settings row."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Both choices persist across reloads (localStorage). A saved third-party skin is
re-applied once on b"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"oot (DSH only persists system/light/dark itself)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DSH's theme system is token-based: the web shell ships `--dsw-*` design tokens,
and `ThemeRuntime` l"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ets third-party plugins register themes that override the
alias layer (`--dsw-alias-*`) per color sc"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"heme. This package is a regular
dual-face plugin:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) — a `dsh.bundle` patch layer that inserts one
loader entry (`skin`)"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"; a no-op `apply`, exactly like the shipped ui-* packages.
- **Browser half** (`lib/client.js`) — a "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"`dsh.client` bundle (served at
`/plugins/dsh-skin/client.js`) that:
1. registers 7 curated skins via"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" `ctx.theme.register(...)`;
2. restores the saved skin id and applies it with `ctx.theme.setTheme(.."},{"id":"p8s5","text":".)`;
3. renders the wallpaper as a fixed backdrop layer (`z-index: -1`) and stacks
a token override "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"(`ctx.theme.overrideTokens`) that makes the main canvas
(`--dsw-alias-bg-base`) and sidebar (`--dsw-"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"specific-sidebar-fill`)
translucent, so the image shows through while inner surfaces (cards,
inputs,"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" bubbles) stay opaque and readable;
4. keeps the slot stores in sync with `theme/change` (and re-sha"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"des the
wallpaper when the active skin or light/dark scheme changes);
5. mounts both rows into `sett"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ings.general.item`;
6. mounts the desktop pet (a fixed, draggable element with inline-SVG
stickers) "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"and watches the agent's running state through
`ctx.get("sessions").list()` to switch moods."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Each skin sets its `colorScheme` (`light`/`dark`), which drives
`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`, plus ali"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"as-token overrides applied as inline custom
properties on `<body>` by ui-layout's ThemePresenter."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Skins"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| id        | scheme | vibe                              |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| `skin-ocean` | dark   | DeepSeek-blue deep sea            |
| `skin-graphite`| dark   | neutral mo"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"nochrome                |
| `skin-forest` | dark   | green calm                        |
| `skin-sun"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"set` | dark   | warm purple                       |
| `skin-midnight`| dark   | pure black OLED     "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"              |
| `skin-paper` | light  | warm paper                        |
| `skin-sakura` | ligh"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"t  | pink accents                      |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Ids are namespaced (`skin-*`) so they do not collide with official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conso"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"le` themes (`sakura`, `graphite`). Saved unprefixed ids are migrated on read."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Picking **默认 / Default** reverts to the built-in appearance (follow system)
and clears the stored sk"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"king **默认 / Default** reverts to the built-in appearance (follow system)
and clears the stored skin."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Wallpaper"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"In **Settings → General → 背景图片 / Wallpaper**:- **选择图片 / Choose image** — pick a local image (≤ 2MB, "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"stored as a data
URL, kept in this browser only). Local video files are not uploaded; paste a URL in"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"stead.
- **网址 / URL** — paste http(s) / data image or video (mp4/webm/ogv/mov). blob is rejected (di"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"es on reload). No extra media server.
- **显示方式 / Fit** — cover / contain / stretch / tile.
- **界面遮罩 "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"/ UI wash** and **模糊 / Blur** sliders (rAF-coalesced; no crash). Higher wash = more solid UI.
- **移除"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" / Remove** clears it."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The wallpaper lives on a `z-index: -1` fixed layer, so it is only visible
through the translucent ma"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"in canvas and sidebar; message surfaces keep their
solid backgrounds for readability. It also follow"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"s your active skin's tint
(switching skins re-shades the translucent surfaces)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 奶龙桌宠 / Pet"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"In **Settings → General → 奶龙桌宠 / Pet** you can show/hide the pet, resize it
(64–180 px) and reset it"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"s position. Behavior:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Status moods** — the dragon follows the agent: `thinking` when a turn
starts, `working` while it"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" runs, `done` (with sparkles) when it finishes,
then back to `idle`. Left idle too long it falls asl"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"eep (`sleeping`, Zzz).
- **Sticker pack (表情包)** — hover the pet and open 🎨: 8 moods to pick
(idle / "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"happy / thinking / working / done / sad / surprised / sleeping).
Clicking the pet also cycles to a r"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"andom sticker for a few seconds.
- **Draggable** — drag it anywhere; the position is remembered
(`ds"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"h-skin:pet-pos`). Reset it from the settings row.
- **Zero assets** — every sticker is inline SVG (o"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"riginal hand-drawn art in a
Nai-Long style, not the licensed character), so the bundle stays depende"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"ncy-
free and crisp at any size. `preview.html` in the repo shows the full pack."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Persistence"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Choices are stored in `localStorage` (`dsh-skin:skin`, `dsh-skin:wallpaper`,
`dsh-skin:wallpaper-opa"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"city`, `dsh-skin:wallpaper-blur`, `dsh-skin:wallpaper-fit`,
`dsh-skin:pet-enabled`, `dsh-skin:pet-si"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ze`, `dsh-skin:pet-pos`).
DSH's Host settings wire only exposes an allowlisted set of namespaces to
"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"browser clients (`WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` in `dsh-host-apiproxy`), so a
third-party namespace would"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" answer `settings-not-exposed`; the product itself
keeps remote browser preferences process-local, a"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"nd localStorage matches that
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
